LF-ground.reason: groundRichness 2 and adGroundRich 2: layers exist (two lawn tones, sidewalk, front walk, shrubs, tufts) but the lawns are flat with hard edges and there are no beds, litter or tone patches in the foreground.

LF-light.reason: light 3 and palette 3; trunks stay distinct against lawn and sky, the faint shadows fall right and toward the camera as sun az 225 requires, green crowns and lawns read as late summer, and exposure has no clipping (luma p5 76, p95 226); the architecture is flat because of flat albedo, not exposure.

LF-trees.reason: silhouettes 3, adRegional 3 and the late-summer season is right, but the mid-right tree and the left parkway row are stacked smooth balls on thin trunks, with two or three adjacent near-identical crowns (section V faults); outranked as a fix by light, ground and buildings.

LF-sky.reason: Clear blue gradient (about 97,172,209) with sparse, simple cloud wisps at the right edge and no sun disk (the sun is out of frame, left of the field and above it); palette-consistent with the mock, though little sky shows between the crowns.

gaps: Sun/shade separation: the mock lays bold, soft, cool grey-blue tree shadows across road, lawn and sidewalk with a darker trunk base; the frame's shadows are near-invisible bands at phone size, so the afternoon reads flat and evenly lit.

Ground colour and tone: the mock has an olive lawn (about 135,148,95), a warm cream sidewalk (about 207,198,186) and a neutral dark-grey road (about 105,113,123); the frame has a minty lawn (111-144,163-179,96-112), a cool white sidewalk (223,228,222) and a blue-slate road (101,127,144), all flat and more saturated (colourfulness 67 vs 49).

House and trunk material: the mock's left block and right houses are muted red brick with cream stone courses and slate hip roofs over warm brown trunks; the frame has a flat saturated orange wall, a flat khaki plinth, flat tan and salmon boxes with no visible roofs, and grey-brown trunks.

Forms and materials: the block mock's houses are brick (red and tan) with cream stone trim, dark slate roofs, gable dormers and bays; the frame's houses are flat-paint boxes with flat tops, one columned portico and cream window surrounds, and no roof visible.

Porches and yards: the mock has stoops with black iron railings, gabled or columned porch roofs, layered foundation planting (round, columnar and clipped shrubs), mulch and flower beds and front walks to the doors; the frame has one stoop with a thin brown rail, a hedge and two or three shrubs, flat lawns and a pale walk that stops short of any door.

Palette variety: the mock mixes brick red, tan brick and cream with navy doors and dark roofs; the frame's orange, tan, salmon and cream fills are more saturated and less brick-like, with teal doors and windows and no dark roof colour to anchor them.

Paving colour and material: the sheet's asphalt is neutral charcoal (kit #626A70, about 98,106,112) with fine speckle and soft tree-shadow patches, over warm beige concrete walks (#C5C0B3) with expansion joints; the frame's asphalt is a flat blue-slate (about 101,127,144) with no grain and faint shadow streaks, and its sidewalk is cool white (223,228,222) with faint joints.

Curb: the sheet has a raised cream concrete curb with a lit top and shaded face, a gutter pan and a driveway apron where the drive crosses the walk; the frame has only a flat pale-grey stripe (about 190-214,204-222,207-219) between lawn and asphalt, with no curb face, and the drive or alley mouth is a flat slate cut across the walk with no apron.

Markings and crossings: roads-08 and roads-09 show crisp warm-white (#EEE9D9) edge lines set in from the curb, lane or centre lines and zebra crosswalks with curb ramps and tactile pads; this frame shows only the single pale edge stripe and no lane line, stop bar, crosswalk or curb ramp (none is in view, so the markings stage cannot be judged beyond the edge).

grade.vsPrevious: unchanged: only the lower-left front lawn differs (a lighter, yellower green, about RGB 144,179,112 against 122,170,102 in the 14:59 run), which adds a little lawn tone variation against the darker parkway lawn but moves no score; buildings, trees, road, sidewalk, sky and light are the same.
grade.summary: At phone size this is the mock's Roscoe scene in flat-shaded form: camera, layout, sky, foliage colour and exposure match, but the minty lawns, cool white sidewalk, blue-slate curbless road and flat saturated orange block read as a tidy cartoon rather than a sunlit brick Lakeview block. The single biggest gap is the near-invisible cast shadow and sun/shade contrast that carries the mock's afternoon, with flat over-saturated ground colour and missing brick, roof and planting detail close behind.
